item.title: Replacing a $3000/mo Heroku bill with a $55/mo server
NASA chief suggests SpaceX may be booted from moon mission
item.description:
📝 I’m going to let other space companies compete with SpaceX. NASA already has two different companies contracted to provide lunar landers: SpaceX with its Starship vehicle, and Blue Origin, the space venture founded by Amazon billionaire Jeff Bezos, which is developing a lander called Blue Moon. ) In a statement, NASA press secretary Bethany Stevens said that the space agency gave SpaceX and Blue Origin until October 29 to present “acceleration approaches” for lunar lander development.
🔗 Read more: https://www.cnn.com/2025/10/20/science/nasa-spacex-moon-landing-contract-sean-duffy

item.title: The death of thread per core
item.description:
📝 In an async runtime like async Rust, the model is that a task can yield, which, conceptually, creates a new piece of work that gets shoved onto the work queues (which is "resume that task"). Work can be more evenly balanced. Stealing is an elegant solution to that problem.
🔗 Read more: https://buttondown.com/jaffray/archive/the-death-of-thread-per-core/

item.title: Magit Is Amazing
item.description:
📝 ”, but then I realized that I’ve actually never used Git for almost anything besides cloning repositories… I’ve always been using Magit for almost everything. Sometimes I think whether it would have been better if I started using Git CLI and then switched to Magit, that way I would really understand why it’s called that way, rather than taking all the amazing work behind it for granted. I’m pretty sure this isn’t all what Jujutsu is about, but now I really don’t feel like giving it a try anytime soon because of that article.
🔗 Read more: https://heiwiper.com/posts/magit-is-awesome/
